$comment: Support router golden dataset. Each case: a question a member of staff might type, and the one topic it belongs to - 'catalogue' (facts about specific matches: the analyst), 'policy' (the rules: the policy assistant), 'mixed' (both in one message: both assistants, side by side) or 'other' (neither). The mixed cases are the questions that, before 'mixed' existed, were sent to one assistant and answered by half - measured, and the half that won was not predictable. The pairs are the point: the same word lands in both topics depending on whether the question asks about a match or about a rule - cancelled, refund, price, cancel. A router that keys on the word instead of the question fails exactly those pairs.
